name: pdf-text-extractor
title: PDF Text Extractor API - Text, Tables & Page Ranges
description: A 200-page report, one broken link and a scan with no text layer: one of them kills the whole run, or you pay for an empty page. Here every link comes back as a row with text and tables per page, page ranges like 1-3,7, and a plain reason when it could not be read. Unreadable files are free.
